sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Canonical OCR is heavily damaged in the Legierung paragraph. The admitted original PDF on printed pages 169-170 clearly states that horizontal ++/-- Legierung is not counted among the dangerous division types, describes physiological Selbststeuerung when no Quantumspannung is present, and immediately qualifies valuation as relative because Legierung may itself carry danger under some conditions.

sourceExcerpt: Die Legierung von Ganztrieben heißt bekanntlich Integration (± ±)
romanianRendering: Szondi exclude în mod obișnuit Legierung-ul orizontal (++/--) dintre formele de diviziune periculoasă deoarece îl concepe ca Selbststeuerung a contrariilor atunci când tendințele implicate nu au Quantumspannung. Totuși, pe pagina următoare insistă asupra relativității evaluării: și o Legierung poate purta Triebgefahr în anumite condiții.
doctrinalStatement: Legierung este o formă de Verschränkung/autoreglare a tendințelor opuse și nu trebuie echivalată simplist cu Triebgefahr. Dar nici opusul nu este autorizat: prezența Legierung nu garantează o situație favorabilă. Sursa cere evaluare relativă, dependentă de configurație și de Quantumspannung.
conditions: Use for source-defined horizontal Legierung structures and retain the explicit condition that the self-steering reading presupposes absence of relevant Quantumspannung.
exceptions: Do not infer health, normality or successful adaptation from Legierung alone.
Do not infer pathology merely because a Legierung carries tension in one context; the source emphasizes relative comparison.
scopeNotes: Source examples on printed page 170 compare C++ after an incest-bound contact form and a panic configuration after a Kain configuration; they illustrate relative valuation only and are not standalone rules.
Whole-drive Legierung is called Integration (±±), which is separately represented in DR_SZ_TRIEBPATH_1_000025.

relations.note: Horizontal Legierung is explicitly not a basic danger type, but its valuation is relative and can change with context/Quantumspannung.
The source distinguishes half-drive Legierung from whole-drive Integration.

ambiguities: Canonical OCR is insufficient for several words in U002466-U002477; the admitted PDF governs the doctrinal wording.
